notes:
Target account: building an in-IDE PR review assistant (VS Code + GitHub App). Primary ask: summarize diffs, generate review comments, rerank candidate suggestions by repo heuristics. Emphasis on low-latency streaming for in-editor experience and deterministic comment output for CI gating. Sensitive IP — VPC/on-prem preferred. Wants model pinning & rollback, per-route token quotas, and audit logs. POC running against 10 internal repos (mixed mono-repo). Typical PRs: 200-2000 LOC with multi-file renames and generated code. SE call notes: 'Latency is king for in-IDE suggestions; we can't have >100ms tail p50/p95 for completions' — they mean hot-path <50ms where possible. They also asked about token accounting per repo and retention. Pricing sensitive but willing to pay for dedicated predictable latency.
Quick bullets:
- repo types: python, ts, go, some java
- target latency: streaming suggestions <50ms hot-path, p95 <250ms for larger summaries
- POC metric: reviewer acceptance rate, false-positive comment rate, infra cost per 1M tokens
- security: VPC + KMS, SOC2/ISO requirement, data residency EU for some clients
- integration: GitHub App + webhook, VS Code extension telemetry (opt-in), CI check gating
